title: BreakGlassAlertRaisedPayload
description: Payload of the BreakGlassAlertRaised platform event (class: platform; INV-REQ-897 b1, INV-Q-8839 option A). access-svc emits it for each break-glass unlock and each recorded action. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

accCode.description: The access alert code; only ACC-002 is emitted today.

scope.description: What the break-glass use concerns: a tenant or an installation.

action.description: The break-glass step that raised the alert.

unlockRef.description: The break-glass unlock the alert belongs to, when there is one.

overrideReason.description: The override reason the unlock carried, when it carried one.
